variables.label: Air temperature
variables.definition: Temperature of the air 2 m above the ground.

variables.label: Humidity
variables.definition: How close the air is to holding all the water vapour it can.

variables.label: Haze
variables.definition: How much dust, smoke, pollution and sea salt dims sunlight. 0 = perfectly clear.

variables.label: Desert dust
variables.definition: The part of the haze made of desert dust.

variables.label: Rainfall (model)
variables.definition: Rain and snow, from the MERRA-2 model corrected with rain gauges.

variables.label: Rainfall (satellite)
variables.definition: Rain measured by the Global Precipitation Measurement satellites.

variables.label: Evaporation
variables.definition: Water leaving the land and plants into the air.

variables.label: Runoff
variables.definition: Rainwater flowing off the surface towards rivers.

variables.label: Topsoil wetness
variables.definition: How wet the top layer of soil is: 0 = bone dry, 1 = soaked.

variables.label: Soil moisture
variables.definition: Water held in the top 10 cm of soil (1 kg/m² ≈ 1 mm of water).

derived_fields.name: Offline GeoNames reverse geocode of the box centre; "Remote area" when the nearest populated place is over 250 km away.
derived_fields.climate: Simplified Koppen class from the box's own 2000-2024 monthly T2M and PRECTOTCORR.
